property_summary: For any bytes4 interfaceId, supportsInterface returns the same boolean as checking interfaceId against type(IERC1155).interfaceId OR type(IERC1155MetadataURI).interfaceId OR super.supportsInterface; the bug omits the MetadataURI check, so it returns false when it should return true for that specific interface.
change_summary: Replace IERC1155MetadataURI with IERC1155 in the second conditional check
